title: Integrable hierarchies with zero dispersion and elliptic curves
summary: We consider integrable hierarchies such as KP, modified KP, 2D Toda lattice, BKP (small and large), DKP, Pfaff-Toda and their multi-component generalizations. We work in the framework of the bilinear formalism in which the universal dependent variable is a tau-function satisfying bilinear equations of the Hirota-Miwa type. Our principal interest in this paper is the dispersionless versions of the hierarchies.
